_comment: Shader presets for tools/setup_client.py (--shaders quality|vr|off). 'shader' is the manifest slug of the pack Iris starts with; 'options' are that pack's own option names (written to shaderpacks/<file>.txt); 'iris' goes into config/iris.properties; 'game_options' replace lines of options.txt (render distance is the big cost); 'mods_off' are manifest mods left disabled (.jar.disabled) in this preset. Tuned from the shader gallery (work/shots/shaders, tools/visual/plans/shaders.json): see the report of the mods phase 2.

quality.description: Complementary Reimagined, tuned for the piece: warm noon, coloured block light, no light fog or shafts

vr.description: Complementary Reimagined on its LOW profile (very low shadows, no light shafts, no coloured light), same colour grade
